rules.if: candidate compares substantive values, conditions, or facts at different times or in distinctly titled dated documents, without asserting an explicit document-version event, identity, state, relation, or transition
candidate describes a currently applicable substantive value in a dated notice or answer, but does not assert that the document itself is a current version

candidate explicitly asserts original/revised/current/historical document-version identity, amendment/repeal/replacement, predecessor/successor, supersession, amendment-decision identity, or document effective/expiry transition
rules.then: version_claim_status is PRESENT_*; correctness requires frozen Evidence

rules.if: a historical or cross-time substantive claim is evidence-supported but makes no document-version assertion
rules.then: overall_fact_status may be LEGITIMATE_VERSION_OR_HISTORY while version_claim_status == NOT_PRESENT
